name: Wavelet Slice Compression (Video Coding Approach)
aliases: Video Coding Approach for Wavelet Compression
definition: A compression schema based on wavelets that treats 3D data as separate correlated slices to exploit temporal/spatial coherence amongst these slices, similar to video coding techniques.
summary: Wavelet Slice Compression partitions 3D volumes into 2D slices and applies video coding techniques to exploit temporal coherence, separating spatial and temporal compression for higher efficiency.
